div.head: List of Persons
div.p: Editor’s Note—The identification of the persons in this list is generally limited to positions and circumstances under reference in this volume and is confined to the 1952–1954 period. Where no dates are given, the individual usually held the position throughout that period. All titles and positions are American unless otherwise indicated. This list does not include individuals referred to only in passing, although such individuals are sometimes identified in context as their names appear.
